{{Nickname}}
'''Name It, Claim It Law''' was a term used for a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] development decree that allowed an individual to take control of [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] by locating them, performing a life-form scan, and filing for development rights.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|358|Name It, Claim It Law}}</ref> Infamously abused by the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] during the [[Old Republic era]], this law caused a notable charting of new systems and planets on maps and asset lists, but added little beyond surface level knowledge of worlds.<ref name="Specter of the Past">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref>
